checks: The ramp is the minimum of two affine functions, so is concave and continuous; its values are between 1/2 and one before the positive normalization factor.

Independently integrate with the primitive s log s−s between 1/2 and one. Multiplication by 2t gives t(log 2−1). The log shift ct cancels this over [0,1], but contributes only ct² on the removed interval [0,t], giving −ct+ct² and scaled limit −c≠0.

The log is bounded uniformly on the shell of length t and is ct outside it, so it converges in L¹ and the parameter converges uniformly on each fixed interior core. On the retained interval the parameter is exactly e^(ct), which cancels in the new geometric normalization.
